name: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Aug)
note: Prices Paid held 71.1. Softer headline, still expansion.

name: FOMC Rate Decision
note: 10-2 vote. Cook and Hammack dissented for 25bp hike. Economy 'strong'; inflation elevated. Dec hike odds ~85-86%.

name: GDP Q3 (advance)
note: BEA official. Investment + consumer + govt; exports down, imports up. Real final sales to private domestic +4.9%. Core PCE Q3 +2.5%.

name: Initial Jobless Claims
note: DOL week ending Oct 24. 4-wk avg 196.75k. Continuing 1.701M. Soft, labor still tight.

name: PCE / Personal Income (Sep)
note: BEA official. Headline PCE hotter m/m. Keeps Dec hike live (~81-82% post-FOMC).

name: Employment Cost Index (Q3)
note: BLS official. Wages +0.7%, benefits +0.9%. In-line, not inflationary. Dec hike odds ~68-73%.

name: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Oct)
note: Beat. Production 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021). New Orders 55.5. Prices Paid 75.2 (from 77.9). Expansion continues.

name: JOLTS Job Openings (Sep)
note: BLS official. Little changed at 7.5M. Quits increased to 3.4M. Openings rate 4.5%. Labor demand resilient ahead of NFP.

name: ADP Employment Change (Oct)
note: ADP official. Beat. Services-led; professional/business services -27k. Matches Sep revised.

name: ISM Services PMI (Oct)
note: ISM official. Slight miss. New orders 55.9 (from 59.8), employment 51.4 (from 50.1), prices 73.0 (from 74). Expansion continues.

name: Initial Jobless Claims
note: DOL week ending Oct 31. 4-wk avg 194.75k. Continuing 1.718M. Soft, labor still tight.

name: NFP / Employment Situation (Oct)
note: BLS official. Hot beat. Sep revised to +60k. Broad gains (prof/bus +70k, health +42k). Dec hike odds ~78-80%.

name: UMich Sentiment (Nov P)
note: Official. Beat. Current 51.0, expectations 50.9. 1y infl 4.3% (from 4.7%), 5y 3.4%. Independents-led.

name: CPI (Oct)
note: BLS official. Hotter than expected. No YoY (prior shutdown). Dec hike odds ~100% (25bp ~85%, 50bp ~15%).
